name: Regulus
bio: Archetype: Dodge, Crit-Rate Dependent, AP-Generous. ⌽ Great defensive Ult that applies [Riot and Roll] to all allies, allowing them to dodge to all non-Ult attacks for 1 turn. ⌽ Can skip a turn to gain [Restless Heart]. Casting a skill consumes [Restless Heart] to gain increased Crit Rate, converts excess Crit Rate into Crit DMG and gain 1 additional Moxie. ⌽ S2 reduces enemy Moxie on Crit. ⌽ Powerful but with few early-game use cases. ⌽ Synergy: Crit-oriented units. (Lilya, Voyager, Tooth Fairy, etc.)
